messages.author: fb1667ba74f25458
messages.subject: Stan syntax for Notepad++
parts:
Hi all,
I tend to use Notepad++ a lot and I have thus created an UDL file to have syntax highlighting for Stan in Notepad++ (the file is attached). To use, simply open "Language -> Define your language", click "Import" and select the file.

Feedback is welcome!

Martin Cerny

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Stan syntax for Notepad++
parts:
Cool, thanks for sharing! Notepad++ is for Windows only, right? Most (if not all) of the Stan developers use either Linux or Mac exclusively (although we do tests on Windows) so I'm not sure if any of us can actually try this out easily. But we do have a lot of users who run Stan through Windows so hopefully some of them will chime in here and give you some good feedback.  

Jonah
